lead: Anthropic IPO priced at $83 a share

Giri vs Firouzja for the title
text: Ogra cut petrol by Rs3 to Rs322 a litre and high-speed diesel by Rs3 to Rs355 from 19 November; petrol is Rs6 cheaper than two days ago.
four flaws added as exploited on 18 November, in BerriAI LiteLLM (CVE-2026-40217), Synology DSM, Apache Axis and REDCap; self-hosted AI gateways should patch and rotate admin keys.
remote code execution in Java 17.0.6 and later, 21, 25 and 27 on x86 servers with AVX-512 VBMI; Java 8 and 11 are unaffected, fixed builds are out and exploit attempts have been seen.
Giri beat Vachier-Lagrave on both days and Firouzja beat Caruana in Armageddon; they meet in the final on 19–20 November.
priced at $83 a share, above the $70–78 range, valuing the company at about $1.5tn; shares trade as ANT on Nasdaq from 19 November.
nonstop Port Moresby–Auckland flights resumed on 17 November, three a week, on Boeing 737-800s.
